scope: credential-free model catalog drift field-to-model observability
claims: Drift reports expose a deterministic changedFieldModelIds object keyed by canonical changed field path.
Each field maps to the sorted identifiers of changed models containing that field path.
Unchanged and source-revision-only reports expose an empty changedFieldModelIds object.
Field-to-model mappings are deeply immutable and every structural drift remains review_required and failClosed.
boundary: Static field-to-model drift evidence does not prove live provider availability, supported controls, or output quality.
